text:
anita: Heads up — main CI turned red on model-serving-integ (linux-arm64). Failing test: `serve_kv_cache_integration.test_write_back` (3/3 shards). Last green on main was commit `0a1b2c3`. Can someone bisect? CI job: https://ci.redwood.dev/job/12345 :grimacing:

sam: I'll take a first pass. starting `git bisect` locally, will try to reproduce the failing job. @ci-bot can you rerun only the failing shard (shard 2)?

ci-bot: rerun scheduled — job 12345 shard 2 queued (ID: 12345-2-rerun). ETA ~6m.

lee: if you need me to run a wider bisect matrix (arm64 vs x86) I can spin up the farm. suspect recent allocator tweak in PR #4381 though.

sam: quick repro locally with qemu-arm: reproduced OOM during test at step "flush_prefixes". stack snippet below:
```
E tensorflow: allocator.cc:412] Allocation failed: Out of memory while allocating 64MB
  at serve::kv::MemTracker::Allocate (mem_tracker.cc:87)
  at serve::kv::Cache::WriteBack (cache.cc:213)
```

jake: interesting — the allocator change in #4381 touched the mem tracking boundary checks. could be an off-by-one that only shows up under arm64 memory layout.

sam: bisect progress: last-good `0a1b2c3` (main~5), first-bad `d4e5f6a7` (main~2). running `git bisect run ./tools/ci_repro.sh -- --test serve_kv_cache_integration` now.

maya: FYI logs attached from the CI rerun: https://ci.redwood.dev/job/12345/console. Rerun failed in the same spot with identical stack. :frowning:

lee: thanks — if bisect narrows to a single commit I can prepare a revert PR quickly. Heads-up to oncall: this impacts nightly deploys for dedicated customers.

sam: bisect found suspect commit `7f8e9d0` authored by @matt (allocator: tighten boundary checks). It reproduces 100% in my qemu run.

anita: OK — plan: lee opens a revert for `7f8e9d0` and we run a CI smoke. If green, we'll cut a fastfix patch. @devops-bot, raise a priority for the revert?

devops-bot: please file a PR and add label `hotfix/ci-regression` — automated deploys require PR approval and release tagging.

lee: opening revert now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/revert-7f8e9d0 PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4712 — added changelog and test note.

sam: i'll queue a rerun against that PR once CI picks it up. if it's green we'll merge and roll-forward.

anita: thanks everyone. keep updates in this thread. once merged I'll notify customer-facing teams. :white_check_mark:
